A [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Swooper/Legends|swooper]] wearing a '''graysuit''' rode in the [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba the Hutt's]] [[Gizz's Gang|swoop gang]] during the [[Swoop gang/Legends|gang's]] failed [[Assassin/Legends|assassination]] attempt of the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] in [[3 ABY/Legends|3.5 ABY]]. During the encounter the graysuit swooper, while pursuing Skywalker on [[Swoop/Legends|swoop]] bike, failed to clear the natural rock formation in Tatooine's [[Beggar's Canyon/Legends|Beggar's Canyon]] known as the [[Stone Needle/Legends|Stone Needle]]. The swooper's bike crashed into the rocks, killing him in a [[Fire/Legends|fiery]] explosion.
